title: Worth visiting!
text: We visited this little area of artisans and museums and enjoyed the 1/2 day we spent there walking around, taking photos and having lunch.  Audio is not worth purchasing.  A handset is provided, no earphones so you have to select the number of what you want to hear and listen to it while holding it like a phone.  The numbers on the wall do not correspond with the numbers of the audio.
author: JWebb356
